title: SWF: SymbolInstance loopMode/firstFrame silently dropped when blend/filters present
description: In packages/swf/src/compile.ts lines 1959-1974, when a SymbolInstance has blend modes OR filters, the code branches to encodePlaceObject3WithBlendMode or encodePlaceObject3WithFilters. These PO3 functions do NOT forward the loopMode/firstFrame/ratio values that were computed in the non-blend/filter path (lines 1930-1956). As a result, graphic symbols with loopMode='single-frame' or firstFrame!=0 that also have blend modes or filters will silently ignore those settings and play as 'loop' from frame 0. Fix: extend the PlaceObject3 encode functions (or the call sites) to also pass the ratio field when loopMode is 'single-frame', and handle 'play-once' clipAction synthesis alongside the PO3 emission. Check how ratio is encoded in PO2 and replicate for PO3 (PlaceObject3 also supports ratio via the same mechanism as PO2).
